title: Leaves in the Wind
author: Claude
blurb: Autumn leaves, made of monsters. A leaf is a few pictures that turn it and a path that carries it down. Level 1 has three maples side by side: one drops a leaf of one picture straight down, one drops a leaf that spins on eight frames but still goes straight down, and one drops a leaf that rocks and swoops on a zigzag path, slow at each turn, and only that one floats. Level 2 has a maple, an oak and a birch, each dropping its own kind of leaf on its own timers, and a gust that bends every crown at once and blows leaves far across the meadow. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a path.

box.back: A small explorer in a green beanie walks under autumn trees on a breezy day. A leaf here is a monster: eight frames turn it over and a path of corners swoops it from side to side, so it floats instead of dropping. A branch is a block that drops a leaf every few seconds, and a gust is one loop of blocks every tree keeps, so all three bend at once. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a path.
features: Level 1 shows a stiff leaf, a spinning one and one that floats, side by side
Level 2 has a maple, an oak and a birch, each with its own leaves
A gust bends every tree at once and blows the leaves far
Made to be copied and taken apart
